thread:
Alex P.: quick sync — changelog cutoff for the SDK launch (v1.5) is EOD Thu PST. Can owners confirm status for: sample kit, quickstarts, docs, and changelog bullets? Also flag any blocker deps.

Jess: python SDK PR is ready and awaiting one more review. docs PR is in draft (PR #842). I can write a short changelog blurb if someone lists the bullet points. :+1:

Maria K.: sample-kit tests are failing on CI (node 18). Error looks like a dependency mismatch with eng-runtime’s new request proxy. I opened an issue and tagged @eng-runtime.

Samir: I can take quickstarts bullets and assemble the changelog slice. 2 bullets I have: - new streaming responses flag for node SDK; - improved error codes for bad input. Anything else?

Chris L.: FYI platform changed the token endpoint contract slightly — dedicated capacity example will need a tiny config tweak (env var name). Not a hard blocker but will require a docs patch. I'm happy to send the patch today.

Alex P.: thanks. @Jess can you list the exact API surface changes so Samir can include them in the bullets? Also we need someone to own the sample-kit fix. Maria, can you estimate ETA if eng-runtime lands a patch?

Maria K.: if eng-runtime ships a patch today, I can have sample-kit green by EOD tomorrow. If it slips, ETA becomes early next week. I pinged @eng-runtime in the issue and linked failing logs.

Jess: API surface changes — added `stream: true` option on createCompletion and changed error shape for validation failures to include `error.code`. I'll paste a short blurb below to copy into changelog.

Jess: "Features: added streaming responses option for Node/Python SDKs. Repairs: normalized error responses with `error.code` for failed validation. Misc: minor telemetry opt-out fix."

Samir: perfect, I'll slot that in. Who's owning the quickstart copy update? I can update code snippets but need someone to sanity-check wording.

Chris L.: I can review the quickstart wording after lunch. Also I'll open a tiny PR to rename the env var in the Dedicated example and CC docs.

Alex P.: plan:
- Jess lands SDK PR + drop finalized changelog blurb (owner: Jess)
- Samir composes changelog slice and opens the notes PR (owner: Samir)
- Maria tracks sample-kit CI and coordinates with eng-runtime (owner: Maria K.)
- Chris submits dedicated example env var PR and docs patch (owner: Chris L.)

If everyone can add :thumbsup: when you ack ownership, we'll call this done for the sync. If any blockers escalate, post here so we can triage.

release-bot: Reminder — changelog cutoff: 2026-03-19 23:59:00 PST. Automated release notes draft will be generated 2026-03-20 00:10:00 PST.

Alex P.: acked :thumbsup: — thanks all, I'll follow up with a short checklist later today including links to PRs and the docs issue.
